# Hanvi Events

> Hanvi Events is a premier luxury event planning, bespoke wedding management, and mandap architecture firm based in Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh, India. Specializing in grand destination weddings, traditional Telugu wedding rituals, birthday extravaganzas, stage decor, and corporate galas across East Godavari and coastal Andhra Pradesh.

## Core Information
- **Brand Name**: Hanvi Events
- **Primary Domain**: https://www.hanvievents.com
- **Headquarters**: D.No 70-1-19, Near RTA Office, Nagamalli Thota Junction, Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh 533003, India
- **Geo Coordinates**: 16.945538, 82.235123
- **Primary Phone**: +91 93902 46849 / +91 93922 46849
- **Email**: info@hanvievents.com / contact@hanvievents.com
- **Operating Hours**: Monday to Sunday, 09:00 - 21:00 IST (24/7 on-call event coordination)

## Key Pages & Services
- [Home](https://www.hanvievents.com): Complete luxury event portfolio and signature concepts.
- [Services](https://www.hanvievents.com/services): Full spectrum event design and turnkey production.
- [Wedding Planning](https://www.hanvievents.com/services/wedding-planning): Bespoke wedding planning, Muhurtham sets, Sangeet & Pellikuthuru setups.
- [Mandap Design](https://www.hanvievents.com/services/mandap-design): Royal floral mandaps, contemporary acrylic & temple architecture backdrops.
- [Birthday Events](https://www.hanvievents.com/services/birthday-parties): Themed 1st birthday celebrations, cradle ceremonies & milestone parties.
- [Corporate Events](https://www.hanvievents.com/services/corporate-events): Brand launches, annual summits, executive conferences & award nights.
- [Portfolio](https://www.hanvievents.com/portfolio): Curated gallery of luxury weddings, floral stages, and themed decor.
- [About Us](https://www.hanvievents.com/about): Our heritage, creative vision, and leadership team.
- [Contact](https://www.hanvievents.com/contact): Booking consultations, venue walkthroughs, and custom estimates.

## Service Areas
Hanvi Events delivers end-to-end event planning across:
- **Primary**: Kakinada, Rajahmundry, East Godavari, Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Konaseema district
- **Regional Hubs**: Samalkota, Pithapuram, Amalapuram, Peddapuram, Mandapeta, Annavaram, Tuni, Ravulapalem
- **Extended Andhra Pradesh**: Visakhapatnam (Vizag), Vijayawada, Guntur, Eluru, Bhimavaram
